description: Which audit rules the repair engine may fix automatically. Any rule not listed here is left for a human. Data-destructive or content-authoring fixes are never automatic.

TYP001.note: Raises explicit small runs to audit.min_font_pt. Re-audit afterwards: larger text can overflow.

TYP002.note: Replaces unapproved fonts with the theme body font.

TYP003.note: Unifies mixed families inside one text box to the dominant font.

TYP005.note: Removes placeholders that carry no text.

COL001.note: Recolours low-contrast explicit text to the nearest readable theme colour.

COL002.note: Recolours text that matches its background.

GEO001.note: Nudges shapes fully inside the canvas.

A11Y003.note: Moves the title placeholder to the front of the shape tree.

A11Y005.note: Marks the first row of a table as a header row.

A11Y002.note: Generates alt text from the nearest caption or file name; review the wording.

LNK001.note: Strips blocked hyperlink protocols from runs.
